Eclipsed Village }} ==Description== The '''Overworld''' is one of the many realms that was spawned from the seed of Paradise, and is the realm to which the main events of the game's story line take place. It is mainly supposed to be the equivalent to Earth, but certain elements of the realm indicate that the '''Overworld''' also shares similarities to what Robloxia is supposed to be, from official Roblox material. ==Inhabitants== The primary inhabitants of the '''Overworld''' are known as humans.{{InlineQuote|It is stronger and faster, leading it to sprint towards humans and other creatures.|[[Quick]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} Like humans in the real world, the humans of Tower Defense Simulator seem to be the apex species of their world, dominating the globe. Though, whether the humans of Tower Defense Simulator share the same, or similar histories and upbringings of the humans of the real world remains unknown, as the Robloxia-inspired elements of the '''Overworld''' could possibly influence elements of humanity. Zombies are another set of beings that inhabit the '''Overworld''', they are the undead corpses of humans that have been mutated and animated to life by the effects of [[Serum Zero]] developed by Oasis X Enterprise laboratories.Name mentioned in the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vk7eFSlSzNA Patient Zero trailer] and on the thumbnail for [[v1.20.0]]. It is unknown when the zombies first started appearing in the '''Overworld''', but as of [[The Final Act Event]], they seem to retain a sizable global population.{{InlineQuote|What used to be our home is now a dumping ground for trash and tetanus. But hey, at least it doesn't have a zombie problem THAT YOU KEEP FORGETTING TO FIX.|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 26 (Easy & Hard, [[Blind Faith]])}} From certain cinematic material, zombies possess an intelligence of some degree and a drive for self-preservation.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yWi2vvQ0i5U
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XWIeYUnLpVs Lesser known entities known as [[Pumpkid|Pumpkids]] and [[Swamper|Swampers]]During the first [[A Dark Tale]] cutscene. have been shown to be living in the '''Overworld'''. It can be assumed that they are each their own separate species of monsters native to the realm, and that there is likely more of them not shown in the game. ==Groups== The [[T.D.S. Organization]] is the protagonist force in the Tower Defense Simulator story and is a primary faction whose operations are based from the '''Overworld'''. Their goal is to fight back against the zombies, Molten, [[Fallen (Story)|Fallen]], and any other force that wishes to pose a threat to humanity and the world. As of the [[Null & Void Event]], they also worked to secure [[God Cube]] fragments, whether it be from within the '''Overworld''' or from other realms. But after [[Lord Exo]]'s freedom from the [[God Cube]], the [[T.D.S. Organization]]'s new focus is trying to limit the damage of the [[Meta]] falling apart, and fight back against any destruction that [[Lord Exo]] might cause. The [[Children of Exo]] are a mysterious cult and terrorist organization whose goal is to free [[Lord Exo]] from his prison. As of the [[Null & Void Event]], they have achieved their goal. They are aligned against the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. The Dark SunName comes directly from a few pieces of dialogue in [[Totality Tower]]. is an enigmatic faction lead by [[The Umbra]]. They had been working in the shadows to retrieve [[God Cube]] fragments for their Mistress. Their attempts were thwarted many times by the [[T.D.S. Organization]], with [[The Umbra]] ultimately being defeated at [[Totality Tower]], and the Dark Sun presumably along with her. ==Locations== {{Map:Overworld}} ===T.D.S. Bases=== {{LocationInfobox |title = T.D.S. Bases |image = |-|T.D.S. HQ = [[File:TDSHQ.jpg]] |-|Outpost 32 = [[File:Outpost32.jpg]] |-|Outpost 16 = [[File:Outpost16.jpg]] |purpose = Bases of Operations |creator = [[T.D.S. Organization]] |owner = [[T.D.S. Organization]] }} The [[T.D.S. Organization]] has several bases of operation that span the '''Overworld'''. Each of these locations are unique and serve distinct purposes for the agency. T.D.S. Headquarters, or T.D.S. HQ, is the primary base of operations that the agents are seen working from. From there, they are deployed onto the battlefield for missions. [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] is the organization's portal research base that they use to study interdimensional travel using the [[God Cube]] shards they had collected. [[Outpost 16]] is the testing facility that the organization used to conduct Project God Merger during the [[Null & Void Event]]. {{Clear}} ===Cyber City=== {{LocationInfobox |title = Cyber City |image = Cybercity.jpg |purpose = City |citizens = [[Professor V]]{{InlineQuote|[[Professor V|V]] has been creating technology in [[Cyber City]] for years, so I trust her to figure something out.|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 3 ([[Banlands]])}} }} [[Cyber City]] is the only major metropolitan area within the '''Overworld''', apocalypse survivors from around the world are migrated here for better protection from the zombies. From what has been said about the city from various survivors and the [[Sniper]], [[Cyber City]] is not exactly a good place to live as it is quite crowded and many have to fight for work.[[The Beginning]] In modern day, [[Patient Zero]] attempted to unleash his [[Serum Zero]] in [[Cyber City]] to destroy it.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yWi2vvQ0i5U [[Professor V]] has been mentioned to have been creating technology in [[Cyber City]] for years. The alternatively known name for the '''Overworld'''—"''[[Cyber City]] Realm''"—is named after [[Cyber City]], possibly due to it being a major landmark. {{Clear}} ===Abandoned City=== {{LocationInfobox |title = Abandoned City |image = AbandonedCityIconV2.png |purpose = Survivor Settlement |inhabitants=Abandoned City Survivors (Formerly)}} The [[Abandoned City]] is a location in the story of the game that was home to a group of human survivors during the zombie apocalypse in the past. After the survivors migrated out from the city, it has been left entirely abandoned. In Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode]], the [[Commander]] and his team traveled to the [[Abandoned City]] in search of these survivors. {{Clear}} ===Forest Camp=== {{LocationInfobox |title = Forest Camp |image = Forest Camp Remake.png |purpose = Survivor Settlement |inhabitants=Abandoned City Survivors (Formerly)}} The [[Forest Camp]] was a location used by the [[Abandoned City]] survivors as a hide out from the zombie horde before they continued on. The camp was mentioned to have been created just months before the survivors resided there. In Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode]], the [[Commander]] and his team traveled to the [[Forest Camp]] in search of these survivors. {{Clear}} ===U-Turn=== {{LocationInfobox |title = U-Turn |image = UTurnIcon.png |purpose = Survivor Settlement |inhabitants=Abandoned City Survivors (Formerly)}} [[U-Turn]] was the final location used by the [[Abandoned City]] survivors as a hide out from the zombies before the [[T.D.S. Organization]] rescued them. In Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode]], the [[Commander]] and his team traveled to [[U-Turn]] in search of these survivors before attempting to ferry them to [[Cyber City]]. {{Clear}} ===Severing Connection=== {{LocationInfobox |title = Severing Connection |image = SeveringConnectionIcon.png |purpose = Bridge}} [[Severing Connection]], also known as the "''Main Bridge''" on the [[Commander]]'s map, was a location traveled across by the [[T.D.S. Organization]] and the [[Abandoned City]] survivors on their way to [[Cyber City]]. In Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode]], the bridge was blown up by the [[Demoman]] to prevent the zombies from reaching them. {{Clear}} ===Night Station=== {{LocationInfobox |title = Night Station |image = NightStation2.png |purpose = Train Station}} The map of [[Night Station]] is a train station that is located near the Main Bridge. In Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode]], the train station was used as a rest stop by the [[Commander]]'s team and the Abandoned City survivors before continuing on their journey to [[Cyber City]]. {{Clear}} ===Crystal Cave=== {{LocationInfobox |title = Crystal Cave |image = NewCrystalCaveIcon.png |purpose = Crystal Mine}} [[Crystal Cave]] is a mine used by [[Cyber City]] to extract crystals, a source of energy used to power [[Cyber City]]. The [[Trapper]] has been working in the mines of [[Crystal Cave]] as a watchman ever since he was kicked out of the T.D.S. training program. In Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode]], [[Crystal Cave]] was used as an escape route from [[Night Station]] by the T.D.S. agents and the Abandoned City survivors to get away from the zombies that were catching up to them. {{Clear}} ===Extraction Point=== {{LocationInfobox |title = Extraction Point |image = ExtractionPointIcon.png |purpose = Crystal Refinery}} [[Extraction Point]] is an underground refinery located near [[Cyber City]] that is used to process the crystals mined from [[Crystal Cave]] so the minuscule traces of energy within them can be extracted and used to power [[Cyber City]]. In Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode]], the [[Commander]]'s team and the Abandoned City survivors escape through the refinery to the ground level of [[Cyber City]]. {{Clear}} ===Trick or Threat Town=== {{LocationInfobox |title = Trick or Threat Town |image = TrickOrThreat.png |purpose = Town |citizens = [[Ramiel]]{{InlineQuote|When [[Trick or Threat Town]] was attacked, three brothers were saved by TDS from [[Lord Sinister]].|[[Kronus]]' description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} (Formerly)
[[Marcellus]] (Formerly)
[[Kronus]] (Formerly) }} [[Trick or Threat Town]] used to be a thriving community home to many people, including the three brothers within the [[Children of Exo]], [[Ramiel]], [[Marcellus]], and [[Kronus]]. When [[Lord Sinister]] attacked the town in search of the [[God Cube]] fragment held therehttps://x.com/BelowNatural/status/1929759265981346042, the [[T.D.S. Organization]] intervened and the ensuing conflict left the town in ruins, leaving its former population to abandon it.{{InlineQuote|[[Lord Sinister|Sinister]] destroyed our town's reputation after you left, but that's when we've discovered a shard — along with this clown. Our people left the town and were forced to abandon everything.|[[Kronus]] on Wave 29 ([[Blind Faith]])}} {{Clear}} ===Eclipsed Village=== {{LocationInfobox |title = Eclipsed Village |image = [[File:Eclipsedvillage.jpg]] |purpose = Village |owner = Unknown Mining CompanySeen in the opening scene for the first [[Failed Gateway]] cutscene. [[Penumbras]] (Formerly) }} [[A Dark Tale|Eclipsed Village]] is a town that used to exist in the near past of the '''Overworld's''' history, it used to be the hometown of [[The Umbra]] and [[Penumbras]].Seen in [[A Dark Tale]]. At some point in time, it was abandoned, and in the modern day it was acquired by a mining company. In the [[Hexscape Event]], the [[Children of Exo]] set up their operations at [[Failed Gateway|Eclipsed Village]] because it was ground zero for the [[God Cube]]. {{Clear}} ==Notes== {{StoryNavBox}}
